-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #15 - Function Synopsis_Tartaros
function Synopsis_Tartaros()
	SetTransitionType(1)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("synopsis01.fld")
	MoveCamera(835.76, -111.70, -36.46)
	RotCamera(0.24, 2.47, 0.00)

	CreateObject(0, 20017, 801.00, 600.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	wait(3000)
	Book(0)
	PlayCameraNoWait("Synopsis_Town1_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	PlaySound("Sound/Scenario/Prologue/P00_04.ogg")
	wait(1000)
	AniObject(0, 2, 1)
	wait(20000)
	FadeOut(100)
	wait(3000)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Synopsis_Tartaros)
